title: Physical service-curve epoch invalidation and replan
hypothesis: A plan qualified under one service-arrival epoch can become deadline-infeasible after a controlled arrival-pattern change; an epoch guard must stop stale execution and force replanning before a conservative fallback is invoked.
falsifiers: front-loaded forecast lane materially misses the frozen deadline
back-loaded stale execution does not materially miss the deadline
epoch mismatch fails to produce REPLAN_REQUIRED
guarded path invokes stale FAULT_IN anyway
fallback does not expose the expected higher-residency tradeoff
